summary: Iteration 3 — verified 8 batches of improvements: titles sort_by(rating/views/newest), status filter, exact-match search priority, numeric chapter ordering, views_count auto-increment, public GET /api/users/{uid}, watchlist add/check/delete, partial PATCH /api/titles/{tid}, chat welcome bot + edit/delete (auth+admin) + emoji reactions, and new-chapter notification fan-out. Backend: 51/52 tests pass (98.1%) — sole failure is pre-existing GET /api/ 404 from iter1/iter2. Frontend: home sort/status selects, /admin status toggles (60 found), guest /profile/{uid}, service-worker.js + show-notification handler, chat lobby + visible MangaBot welcome + edited-indicator all verified. Two production bugs in the new code were FOUND AND FIXED inline: (1) /api/titles/{tid} returned 500 due to asyncio.create_task on a Motor Future (TypeError); (2) /api/users/search 404 because GET /api/users/{uid} was registered before the static /users/search route (shadowing).

FIXED (in /app/backend/server.py): duplicate GET /users/{uid} registered at line ~224 BEFORE /users/search at line ~410 — FastAPI matched 'search' as a uid, breaking user search. Removed the duplicate route; the one declared after /users/search (in 'Users / Friends' section) is the live handler.
MangaBot welcome trigger uses count_documents == 1 on lobby messages by sender_id — correct one-shot behavior.
/api/messages/{mid} PATCH and DELETE correctly enforce sender-only edit and sender-OR-admin delete with 403 on violation.
/api/messages/{mid}/react toggles user_id in reactions['emoji'] list and prunes empty keys — clean implementation.

Episode ordering uses collation({'locale':'en_US','numericOrdering':true}) on sort('number',1) — verified 1,2,3,...10,11 order on a 100+ chapter title.
list_titles sort_spec dict supports rating / views / newest correctly.
watchlist /check returns {following: bool, status: str|None} — frontend-friendly shape.
Partial PATCH /titles/{tid} whitelists fields including 'status' — correct, prevents privilege fields from being overwritten.
Public profile public_user() strips password_hash — verified.

rca_of_the_issue: BUG 1: server.py:295 originally did `asyncio.create_task(db.titles.update_one(...))`. Motor's update_one returns an asyncio.Future (already scheduled), not a coroutine. asyncio.create_task() requires a coroutine, raising TypeError and triggering a 500 on every GET /api/titles/{tid}. FIX: wrapped in `async def _bump(): await db.titles.update_one(...); asyncio.create_task(_bump())`. BUG 2: GET /api/users/{uid} was declared at line ~224 (before /users/search at line ~410). FastAPI matches routes in declaration order, so GET /api/users/search was captured by the {uid} param handler and returned 404 (since 'search' is not a user id). FIX: removed the early /users/{uid} duplicate; the late declaration (after /users/search) now serves both purposes.
